newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan August index of leading indicators down.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan August index of leading indicators down.

text.p: Taiwan's index of leading business indicators, which forecasts peaks and troughs in the business cycle, fell in August from July, the cabinet's Council for Economic Planning and Development said on Thursday.
The index dropped 0.3 percentage point to 98.0 in August.
The index of coincident indicators rose 0.3 percentage point to 100.3 from July.
The council said the economy remained in a "yellow blue light" condition for the third consecutive month, indicating a possible slowdown.

In a survey, 24 percent of executives in the manufacturing industry said the economy would improve, up from 17 percent in July, while 18 percent said the economy would worsen, down from 22 percent a month earlier.
The rest said the economy would stay unchanged.
